title: Chicken with Creamy Mushroom Sauce
reject_reason: Seared chicken breast in a garlic-parmesan cream mushroom skillet, no starch — the estate already ruled creamy-garlic-parmesan-mushroom-chicken-skillet a dupe of creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet ('mushroom adds no distinct plate'), and live slow-cooker-creamy-chicken-mushroom-bowls covers the same identity.
